accessibility.description: The Graveyard Keeper II Accessibility mod narrates menus, dialogue, cutscene text, surroundings, crafting, building, trading, the graveyard and the morgue through a screen reader or Windows SAPI, and can auto-walk to objects and objectives. This is an early release tested only with the Windows Steam version: only the first squad fight has been played, bow aiming is not supported, the cellar factory is untested, auto-walk sometimes fails to find a route, and the character window map is not read.
